articles.summary: Every safe and efficient voyage is made possible by skilled seafarers whose judgement, resilience and teamwork bring Ardmore’s values to life each day. Their experience and leadership are fundamental to maintaining high standards onboard, adapting to a changing industry and delivering operational excellence across the fleet. Capt. Magone Vitola, Master of the Ardmore Enterprise, reflects Meet Capt. Magone Vitola, Master of the Ardmore Enterprise, as she reflects on her career at sea, leadership, teamwork and a changing maritime industry.
articles.title: In conversation with Capt. Magone Vitola
